newsitem.title: USA: DM Management sees Q2 sales up 50 pct in Q2.
newsitem.headline: DM Management sees Q2 sales up 50 pct in Q2.

text.p: DM Management Co said Tuesday it expects sales for the second quarter ending June 28 to be up about 50 versus last year, and above already revised analysts' estimates of 30 percent sales growth.
Analyst consensus estimates for the company's second quarter earnings per share are $0.15, according to First Call.
The company said it has been targeting new customers at "record levels" this quarter, and has seen a strong surge in response to its late spring season mailings of its catalogs.
DM Management sells women's clothes, accessories, shoes, gifts and cosmetics two catalog, J. Jill and Nicole Summers.
